_comment: NYXUS Station Matrix — single source of truth for workspace 0 (HOME) + stations 1–10. ALIEN THEME ONLY wallpapers (2026-07-23). Synced to workspaces.json, Hyprland defaultName rules, EWW left rail, and nyxus-workspace-wallpaperd.

half_marks._comment: ★ THE ALIEN GLYPH TABLE (2026-07-28) — THE ONLY PLACE THESE TEN LABELS LIVE. Each numbered station 1-10 has a companion ('half') station reached with Super+Alt+<digit>; the EWW left rail draws these glyphs UNDER their primary number, smaller and dimmer. To change the whole look, edit these ten strings and nothing else. Script is TIFINAGH (U+2D30 block) — geometric, genuinely alien, and fully covered by DejaVu Sans, which ships on the ISO via ttf-dejavu. Alternatives scouted and also installed: Old Italic U+10300 (DejaVu Sans), Runic U+16A0 (Noto Sans Runic), Phoenician U+10900, Coptic U+2C81, Glagolitic U+2C00. Greek is covered by JetBrainsMono Nerd Font too, but reads as maths notation rather than alien script. DO NOT let these inherit .ws-word (Permanent Marker) — that display font has ZERO coverage for every one of these blocks and renders tofu boxes.

_half_comment: Each station's `half` block is the companion station's IDENTITY ONLY (name/code/hue/tagline). Its Hyprland workspace rule AND its on-created-empty launch live in conf.d/nyxus-stations-named.conf, because nyxus-hacker-mode REGENERATES conf.d/nyxus-stations.conf from scratch on every mode flip and its generator can only emit the numbered matrix — anything it cannot emit must live in the curated shard or the first toggle deletes it. `name` is the real, greppable Hyprland defaultName (nyxus-home-deck maps stations by name); the glyph above is only the rail label.

stations.name: FORGE
stations.launch: sh -c 'command -v cursor >/dev/null && exec cursor; command -v code >/dev/null && exec code; exec alacritty'

stations.name: WAVE
stations.launch: sh -c 'command -v strawberry >/dev/null && exec strawberry; command -v audacious >/dev/null && exec audacious; command -v cava >/dev/null && exec alacritty --title "NYXUS WAVE" -e cava; command -v pavucontrol >/dev/null && exec pavucontrol; exec alacritty'

stations.name: CORE
stations.launch: sh -c 'command -v thunar >/dev/null && exec thunar; command -v nautilus >/dev/null && exec nautilus; command -v nyxus-files >/dev/null && exec nyxus-files; exec alacritty'

stations.name: MESH
stations.launch: sh -c 'alacritty --title "GowskiNet NOC" -e sh -c "command -v sharknoc >/dev/null && exec sharknoc --watch || exec btop"'
